$comment: Command Governor reviewer profile. Copy to <project>/.pi/settings.json for a
session whose only job is to read a change and report on it.
The difference from the worker profile is `defaultTools`: no `write`, no
`edit`. A reviewer that can modify the code under review can make its own
finding disappear, and the cheapest way to prevent that is to not hand it
the tool. `bash` stays, because independent review means reading git history
and GitHub evidence rather than the implementer's summary.
This is a starting loadout, not an enforced ceiling. Pi has no permission
system and no sandbox, and `bash` can still write files. Real enforcement
arrives with the subagent capability ceilings in Phase C; until then this
file is a default, and harness/authorities.json records that the concern is
